units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2) copies of the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests, if such decisions have been issued;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3) a copy of the document certifying the authority of the individual’s or legal entity’s statutory representative, a copy of the power of attorney or the warrant issued by the relevant lawyers’ organisation certifying the authority of defence counsel or the representative, if the appeal is signed by such persons;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4) copies of the appeal or protest corresponding in number to the other participants in the administrative offence proceedings specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.4 and 25.11 of this Code.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.15

units.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.15

units.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. The judge shall issue a procedural order accepting for consideration an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.15

units.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. A judge who has accepted for consideration an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force must notify the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted and the victim that an appeal or protest has been lodged, and provide those persons with an opportunity to acquaint themselves with the appeal or protest and submit objections to it.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.15

units.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3. If an appeal or protest is lodged in breach of the requirements specified in Article 30.14 and part 4 of Article 30.16 of this Code, it shall be returned to the appellant or the prosecutor who lodged the protest.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.15

units.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.16

units.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.16

units.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. When an appeal or protest has been accepted for consideration, the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests shall be examined on the basis of the arguments set out in the appeal or protest and the objections contained in the response to the appeal or protest.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.16

units.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. A judge who has accepted an appeal or protest for consideration has the right, in the interests of legality, to examine the administrative offence case in full.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.16

units.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3. A decision on an appeal or protest shall be issued no later than two months from the day the appeal or protest is received by the court, or, if the administrative offence case file is requested, no later than one month from the day the case file is received by the court.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.16

units.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4. Repeated appeals or protests on the same grounds to a court that has previously considered the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions on appeals or protests against that ruling that have entered into legal force are not permitted.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.16

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. A decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force shall be adopted in the form of a ruling.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. Following consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force, one of the following decisions shall be issued:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1) to leave unchanged the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest, and to dismiss the appeal or protest against the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2) to amend the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest if the breaches of this Code and (or) the law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences can be remedied without remitting the case for fresh consideration, provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom those ruling and decision were issued;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3) to quash the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest and remit the case for fresh consideration where a substantial breach of the procedural requirements of this Code prevented a comprehensive, full and objective consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4) to quash the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest and terminate proceedings in the case where at least one of the circumstances specified in Articles 2.9 and 24.5 of this Code exists, or where the circumstances on which those ruling and decision were based have not been proved;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 5) to amend the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest, and to replace the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation imposed with another type of administrative penalty in accordance with the procedure specified in part 1.2 of Article 30.1 of this Code;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 6) to leave unchanged the ruling in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code, or to amend that ruling provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom it was issued, and also to quash a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in another article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code concerning the same instance of unlawful actions (inaction), proceedings in which were conducted against the same person, and to terminate proceedings in that case in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 30.17

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. A ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force shall state:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1) the name of the court that considered the appeal or protest;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2) the case number and the date and place of adoption of the ruling;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3) the surname and initials of the judge who considered the appeal or protest;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4) the name of the appellant or the prosecutor who lodged the protest;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 5) identification of the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of appeals or protests being appealed or protested against;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 6) a brief account of the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of appeals or protests being appealed or protested against;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 7) the arguments and requests contained in the appeal or protest;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 8) the objections contained in the response to the appeal or protest;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 9) the reasons and grounds for leaving unchanged, amending or quashing the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force, with references to the articles of this Code and (or) the law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 10) the decision resulting from consideration of the appeal or protest.
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. The ruling specified in part 1 of this article shall be signed by the judge who adopted it.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.18

units.locator: Article 30.19. Entry into legal force of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: A ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force shall enter into legal force on the day it is adopted.

units.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

units.label: Art. 31.1

units.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: A ruling in an administrative offence case shall enter into legal force:
units.label: Art. 31.1 · “A ruling in an administrative offence case shall enter into…”

units.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) upon expiry of the time limit established for appealing against the ruling in the administrative offence case, if that ruling has not been appealed or protested against, except in the cases established by point 4 of this article;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 31.1

units.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) upon expiry of the time limit established for appealing against a decision on an appeal or protest, if that decision has not been appealed or protested against, except where the decision quashes the ruling issued;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 31.1

units.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) immediately after the issue of a decision on an appeal or protest that is not subject to appeal, except where the decision quashes the ruling issued;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 31.1

units.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) on the day the ruling imposing an administrative penalty is issued in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code, where it was committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state, or in a case imposing an administrative penalty for an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and specified in Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting of failure to pay, within the time limit specified by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for committing such an administrative offence.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 31.1

units.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 31.2

units.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 31.2

units.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case is binding and must be complied with by all state authorities, local self-government bodies, officials, citizens and their associations, and legal entities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.2

units.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall be enforced in full from the moment it enters into legal force, except in the cases specified in parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.2

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.label: Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.label: Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: 1. Responsibility for referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement rests with the judge, body or official that issued it.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: 2. Where an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and (or) against a subsequent decision on an appeal or protest has been considered, the ruling in the administrative offence case that has entered into legal force shall be sent to the judge, body or official authorised to refer it for enforcement within three days of its entry into legal force.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: 3. If a ruling in an administrative offence case has not been appealed or protested against within the established time limits, it shall be sent to the body or official authorised to enforce it within three days of its entry into legal force; where an appeal or protest has been considered, this period shall run from the day the decision on the appeal or protest is received from the court or official that issued it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: 3.1. A copy of a ruling (information from such a ruling) imposing an administrative fine issued by a justice of the peace or a commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights shall be sent by them, within the time limits specified in part 3 of this article, to the budget revenue administrator whose details must be included in the ruling imposing the administrative fine in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 29.10 of this Code, electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, or on paper where the technical means are unavailable.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: 4. When sending a ruling in an administrative offence case to the body or official authorised to enforce it, the judge, body or official shall endorse that ruling with the date of its entry into legal force or an indication that it is subject to immediate enforcement.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31.3

units.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
units.text: 5. If a ruling in an administrative offence case imposed a principal and an additional administrative penalty, or measures to secure the administrative offence proceedings were taken or cancelled, duly certified copies of the ruling shall be sent to the bodies or officials authorised to enforce the penalties imposed, apply measures to secure the administrative offence proceedings or release persons from such measures, specifying the part of the ruling in the administrative offence case to be enforced by each respective body or official.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31.3
